question: Which Lviv-Warsaw School philosopher decomposes the notion of hallmark into symptoms and signals?

2.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: Tadeusz Kotarbiński (a core member of the Lviv-Warsaw School via Twardowski) is the philosopher in question. In his work on semiotics and the theory of knowledge (notably Elements of Epistemology, Formal Logic and Methodology), he explicitly decomposes the broad notion of a "hallmark" (or distinguishing mark/znak) into two subcategories: natural symptoms (objawy) and artificial signals (sygnały). This fits the analytic, terminological style of the school; other candidates like Ajdukiewicz or Łukasiewicz focused on related topics in language/logic but not this specific decomposition.

(The translation "hallmark" is likely rendering a Polish term such as "znamię" or "cecha rozpoznawcza.")
